summary: CEMEX SAB de CV filed a Form 6-K announcing the pricing of $1.5 billion of 5.750% senior notes due 2036 under an existing shelf registration. The notes are priced at 99.572% of face value, issued on June 5, 2026, with semi-annual interest. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including potential debt repayment. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no special situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns.
